_comment: Example eligibility criteria for a review of SGLT2 inhibitors in heart failure. Every key is documented in Unified_Engine_Manual.docx section 6.2.
title: SGLT2 inhibitors and heart-failure hospitalisation in adults with heart failure: a systematic review and meta-analysis
question: In adults with heart failure, do SGLT2 inhibitors compared with placebo reduce hospitalisation for heart failure and all-cause mortality?

pico.population: Adults (18+) with heart failure (any ejection fraction)
pico.intervention: SGLT2 inhibitor (dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, sotagliflozin, canagliflozin, ertugliflozin)
pico.outcome: Hospitalisation for heart failure; all-cause mortality
